title: Trace prefix cost and candidate fan-out
description: Select a prefix, change dictionary scale, and cap returned suggestions. The path cost depends on prefix length; the expansion cost depends on how much of the subtree you visit.

queries.label: Broad prefix: ca
queries.detail: A short, popular prefix reaches a node quickly but opens a wide candidate frontier.

queries.label: Narrow prefix: car
queries.detail: A longer prefix performs one more transition and removes unrelated ca branches.

queries.label: Small branch: do
queries.detail: The same prefix length can have a much smaller subtree because data distribution matters.

queries.label: Missing prefix: z
queries.detail: Traversal stops on the first absent edge and never enters descendant enumeration.
